style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

briefs.current_title: AI²机器人郭彦东：人形机器人落地，为何先找场景再谈通用？

subtitles.zh: 请谈谈人形机器人目前的发展阶段。
subtitles.en: So tell us where we are right now in the evolution of humanoid robotics.

subtitles.zh: 在6、7月高峰之后，融资确实有所放缓。
subtitles.en: There seems to have been a fundraising slowdown, no doubt, after August and June and July's peak.

subtitles.zh: 目前行业健康度如何？
subtitles.en: Where is the health of the industry right now?

subtitles.zh: 我认为今年是AI机器人公司寻找更多应用的好时机，
subtitles.en: I think this is a great year and a great timing for all the AI robotics companies to start to find more applications,

subtitles.zh: 为机器人找到更多用途。
subtitles.en: find more usage with robots.

subtitles.zh: 例如，作为AI²机器人公司，我们开始在汽车工厂等多个场景中寻找机器人用途，
subtitles.en: For example, as AS Robotics, we start to find usage of robots in many scenarios, including car plans,

subtitles.zh: 包括农业设施、显示面板公司以及交通枢纽，如机场。
subtitles.en: including file farmer facilities, display panel companies, as well as transportation hubs, such as airports.

subtitles.zh: 如果你今年到访APEC媒体中心，会看到我们的许多机器人，提供咖啡、茶、冰激凌等，
subtitles.en: If you stop by the APEC media center this year, you'll find many of our robots called Afavot, Macoffee, Tee, Muke, Muke Tee, and ice cream

subtitles.zh: 为媒体中心约5000名记者服务。
subtitles.en: for like 5,000 journalists as a media center.

subtitles.zh: 但最大的障碍是什么？
subtitles.en: But what's been the biggest stumbling block

briefs.speaker: Guo Yendong
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and CEO of AI-squared Robotics (AI² Robotics), a Chinese humanoid robotics company
briefs.current_title: AI²机器人郭彦东：轮式人形机器人，如何破解通用操作难题？
current_title_lines: 如何破解通用操作难题？

subtitles.zh: 你可能注意到，我们使用同一类型的硬件、同一单元，将它们应用于不同场景。
subtitles.en: Well, if you may notice that, we are using the same type of hardware, same unit, to apply them in different scenarios.

subtitles.zh: 带轮子的人形机器人，对吧？是的，带轮子的人形机器人。
subtitles.en: Humanoid with wheels, right? Yeah, humanoid with wheels.

subtitles.zh: 这绕过了灵巧性问题以及移动性挑战。
subtitles.en: That gets around the challenge of the dexterity problem, the ambulatory challenges.

subtitles.zh: 是的，但我们仍需解决所谓通用性的问题。
subtitles.en: Yeah, but we still have to need to solve the problem to this kind of so-called general purpose.

subtitles.zh: 我们需要机器人操作咖啡机。
subtitles.en: We need to robot to operate coffee machines.

subtitles.zh: 我们需要机器人在工厂里操作其他机器。
subtitles.en: We need robots to operate other machines in the factories.

subtitles.zh: 我们利用同一单元的机器人，这就是这一代机器人的独特之处。
subtitles.en: We use leverages, same unit of robots. That is the uniqueness of this generation of robots.

subtitles.zh: 所以，真正的挑战是找到基础模型。
subtitles.en: So, the real challenge is to find a foundation model.

subtitles.zh: 有了这个基础模型，人们可以理解人，而机器人可以理解不同环境并操作不同物品。
subtitles.en: With this foundation model, people can understand people. Others, the robot can understand different environment and operate on different stuff.

subtitles.zh: 再比如，媒体中心的机器人操作人们常用的咖啡机。
subtitles.en: For another example, like the robots in the media center, the robot operate on coffee machines, people typically use.

subtitles.zh: 所以，它就像调酒师或咖啡馆好友。
subtitles.en: So, it's like a bartender or cafe bestie.

subtitles.zh: 而且无论光线如何、机器放在哪里、机器类型怎么变，机器人都能操作机器。
subtitles.en: And the robot can operate the machine no matter how the light is, no matter where you put the machine, no matter how change the type of the machine.

subtitles.zh: 但它必须有比制作咖啡更深入的应用。
subtitles.en: But it has to be more profound applications than making coffee.

subtitles.zh: 是的，没错。
subtitles.en: Yeah, exactly.

briefs.speaker: Guo Yendong
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and CEO of AI-squared Robotics (AI² Robotics), a Chinese humanoid robotics company
briefs.current_title: AI²机器人郭彦东：开源Alpha Brain，机器人智能如何加速？

subtitles.zh: 对，没错。你提到的基础模型是Alpha Brain。
subtitles.en: Yeah, exactly. So, your foundational model you're talking about is alpha brain.

subtitles.zh: 是的。我们从Unitree的王兴兴那里听说，通用人工智能的进展可能比我们预期的要快得多。
subtitles.en: Yep. And we've heard, you know, from Unitries, Wang Xingxing talk about the advancements in artificial general intelligence might be coming much faster

subtitles.zh: 你同意吗？是的，我认为事情发展得越来越快。
subtitles.en: than we ever expected. Would you agree with that? Yeah, I think things grow faster and faster.

subtitles.zh: 通常，人们自己写代码，但如今，许多工程师利用大基础模型来写代码。
subtitles.en: Typically, people write codes all by themselves, but these days, a lot of engineers leverage large foundation model to write code.

subtitles.zh: 我认为很多事情发展得越来越快。在2023年，我们是首批真正为机器人发明这种大基础模型的公司之一。
subtitles.en: I think a lot of things get in faster and faster. And in the year 2000-23, I think we are one of the first companies who actually invent this large foundation model for robotics.

subtitles.zh: 我们持续创新。我们不断发表论文，不断申请专利。
subtitles.en: And we keep innovating. We keep publishing papers, we keep applying for patents.

subtitles.zh: 我们开源了名为Alpha Brain的大基础模型。
subtitles.en: And we open source the large foundation model we call that alpha brain.

subtitles.zh: 这样许多人就能用我们的Alpha Brain让他们的机器人越来越智能。
subtitles.en: So that many people can use our alpha brain to make their robot smarter and smarter.

subtitles.zh: 你认为商业化为什么还没有真正起飞？
subtitles.en: What do you think commercialization really hasn't taken off yet?

briefs.speaker: Guo Yendong
briefs.speaker_context: Founder and CEO of AI-squared Robotics (AI² Robotics), a Chinese humanoid robotics company
briefs.current_title: AI²机器人郭彦东：商业化刚起步，数据多样性才是关键？

subtitles.zh: 您认为商业化为何尚未真正起飞？
subtitles.en: What do you think commercialization really hasn't taken off yet?

subtitles.zh: 这些Alpha机器人，不是大脑，而是带轮子的实际人形机器人，有多少台？
subtitles.en: And how many of these alpha bots, not the brain, the alpha bots, the actual humanoid robots with wheels?

subtitles.zh: 部署了多少台？今年和明年的交付情况如何？
subtitles.en: How many are deployed and what are your deliveries like this year and next?

subtitles.zh: 这个问题很好，因为这种人形机器人，我们的通用机器人，并非为非常专业化的任务而设计。
subtitles.en: I see this is a very good question, because this humanoid, our general purpose robots, is not designed for a very specialized task.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们发明硬件、设计硬件、训练基础模型，然后为所有这些机器人找到大量应用。
subtitles.en: So we invent the hardware, we design the hardware, we train the foundation model, then we find a lot of applications for all these robots.

subtitles.zh: 正如我刚才提到的，我们已经找到一些非常有趣、非常有用的应用，比如刚提到的，另外我想提的是这次APEC。
subtitles.en: As I just mentioned, we already find some very interesting applications, very useful applications, such as I just mentioned, and another thing I want to mention is that this is APEC.

subtitles.zh: 我们甚至与PSA新加坡港务局找到应用，帮助港口工人。
subtitles.en: We even find applications with PSA, port of Singapore authority to help the workers at the port.

subtitles.zh: 所有这些应用，首先对开展业务至关重要。
subtitles.en: So all these applications, first of all, is very crucial to run the business.

subtitles.zh: 其次，所有这些不同应用帮助机器人公司追踪数据。
subtitles.en: Second of all, all these different applications help robot company to track data.

subtitles.zh: 因此数据的多样性帮助我们训练机器人的大脑，让机器人越来越智能。
subtitles.en: So the diversity of the data help us to train the brain of the robot to make the robot smarter and smarter.

subtitles.zh: 说到这个，算力短缺对你们有多大影响？
subtitles.en: Well, speaking of which, how are you impacted by perhaps computing power shortages

- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.

Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.

智平方机器人进新加坡港口，多场景数据反哺大脑
clips.comment: KC评论：场景越分散，数据越多样，机器人大脑才有训练素材。

subtitle_comments.comment: KC评论：商业化没起飞，是受访者自己先承认的。
KC评论：带轮子的实际机器人，才是部署主体。
KC评论：交付情况，是检验商业化的硬指标。
KC评论：通用机器人不为单一任务设计，逻辑很清楚。
KC评论：硬件、模型、应用，三条线一起走。
KC评论：APEC场景，是应用清单里的一个样本。
KC评论：与PSA港口合作，把场景拉到海外。
KC评论：应用首先服务业务运转，这是现实考量。
KC评论：不同应用帮公司追踪数据，形成循环。
KC评论：数据多样性反哺大脑，是这条路的底层逻辑。
KC评论：算力短缺的影响，下一问接着展开。

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

briefs.speaker_context: Founder and CEO of AI-squared Robotics (AI² Robotics), a Chinese humanoid robotics company
briefs.current_title: AI²机器人郭彦东：算力受限，机器人模型如何另辟蹊径？
current_title_lines: 机器人模型如何另辟蹊径？

subtitles.zh: 嗯，这是个很好的问题。我做个简单计算。
subtitles.en: Well, this is a really good question. I do simple maths.

subtitles.zh: 我毕业于普渡大学，我为母校感到非常自豪。
subtitles.en: I used to get my degree from Purdue University, I'm very proud of my university.

subtitles.zh: 我做个简单计算。如果继续沿用当前大模型的结构，无论我们有多少电力、多少GPU，
subtitles.en: I do very simple maths. If we keep using the current structure of large foundation model, no matter how much electricity we have, no matter how many GPUs we have,

subtitles.zh: 那都不够。人类没有足够的GPU来为物理世界训练一个完全成熟的通用人工智能。
subtitles.en: that's not enough. So human beings just don't have enough GPU to train a fully completed NGI for physical world.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们需要另辟蹊径来解决这个问题。
subtitles.en: So we need to find another way to solve this problem.

subtitles.zh: 我们发明了一种神经VLA。
subtitles.en: We invented a neural VLA.

subtitles.zh: 我们从人类工作方式中获得了很多灵感。
subtitles.en: We find a lot of inspirations from how people bring work.

subtitles.zh: 因为人类工作非常高效。
subtitles.en: Because people bring very efficient.

subtitles.zh: 训练人类如何思考、如何行动并不需要那么多电力。
subtitles.en: We don't need that much electricity to train people how to think, how to act.

subtitles.zh: 我们尝试研究神经元是如何工作的。
subtitles.en: We try to look at how neurons work.

subtitles.zh: 所以机器人的基础模型需要在边缘端更高效，以降低算力使用。
subtitles.en: So that's the foundation model of the robot needs to be more efficient on the edge to lower the usage of the computing power.

subtitles.zh: 是的，如果做边缘计算，也能减轻电网负担。
subtitles.en: Yeah, and reduce the taxing on the grid as well, if you're doing edge computing.

subtitles.zh: 但话说回来，目前无法获得最先进处理器和GPU，这对你们有多大直接影响？
subtitles.en: But again, how are you right now directly impacted by lack of access to the most cutting-edge processors, GPUs?

- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.

- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

subtitles.zh: 我认为过去几年，市盈率一直低于历史平均水平。

briefs.current_title: 瑞银全球研究主管：芯片自给率提升，科技硬件增长能否持续？
current_title_lines: 科技硬件增长能否持续？

subtitles.zh: 没错，关键问题在于，它们的增长当然来自科技。
subtitles.en: Exactly. That key question. So the growth of them, of course, is coming from tech.

subtitles.zh: 当然，像硬件，你知道，一切都集中在那。
subtitles.en: And of course, like hardware, you know, everything is at that.

subtitles.zh: 我认为现在推动中国的另一个因素，正呼应你提到的自主可控。
subtitles.en: I think now driving China is another thing that is coming to your point about like the self reliance.

subtitles.zh: 谈到AI，我的意思是，对AI芯片的需求毫无疑问是存在的。
subtitles.en: So talking about AI, I mean there's no debate like the demand for AI for chips is definitely there.

subtitles.zh: 供应限制是主要问题，我认为这也是过去几周市场调整的原因之一。
subtitles.en: Supply constraint is office. I think there's also why leading to the market correction in the last couple of weeks.

subtitles.zh: 但现在随着自主可控回归，我们做了一些中期预测，比如到2028年。
subtitles.en: But now with the self reliance coming back, we do some forecasts about like on a medium time basis, let's say going to 2028.

subtitles.zh: 我们的预测是，中国国内芯片出货量将达到约1000万颗。
subtitles.en: Our forecast is China will have domestic chips shipment of like 10 million units.

subtitles.zh: 这大约是今年预测的4.4倍。
subtitles.en: So which is like a 4.4s of forecast for this year.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这种国内平衡的主题正在回归。
subtitles.en: So I guess this domestic balance theme is coming back.

subtitles.zh: 因此，科技硬件增长将继续保持强劲。
subtitles.en: And as a result, tech hardware growth will continue to stay robust.

subtitles.zh: 好的，那么你现在对内地市场最有信心。
subtitles.en: Okay, so you have the strongest conviction in China right now.

briefs.current_title: 瑞银全球研究主管：宏观数据波动下，杠铃策略如何应对？
current_title_lines: 宏观数据波动下如何应对？

subtitles.zh: 很多问题。好，我按要点总结一下，好吗？
subtitles.en: Many questions. Okay, let me sum it up in cue points, right?

subtitles.zh: 我认为首先，就宏观数据而言，我们不能只看昨天或单一数据就形成观点。
subtitles.en: I think firstly, in terms of the macro data, let's not just take yesterday or one single data, you know, following a view.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这个轨迹，如果看过去一个季度从九月到十月，整个趋势是走向温和稳定，就内地宏观而言，
subtitles.en: I think that trajectory, if you look at the past quarter from September leading October, the whole trend is leading to a moderate stability, you know, in terms of the China macro,

subtitles.zh: 这符合预期。所以我们仍有信心。
subtitles.en: which is kind of the expectation it is. So we are still confident.

subtitles.zh: 我会展示给你看，因为数据似乎显示相反。
subtitles.en: I'll show you that because the data seems to be showing the opposite.

subtitles.zh: 我认为如果看九月和十月的组合，这实际上是稳定的情况。
subtitles.en: I think if you look at the combination of September October, this is actually a case of stability.

subtitles.zh: 我们不要单挑昨天。是的。
subtitles.en: Let's not single out yesterday. Yes.

subtitles.zh: 我只是开始获取你提到的数据。是的，没错。
subtitles.en: I'm just starting to get the data to which you're reporting. Yeah, exactly.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，如果看中国增长，4.6%仍是今年剩余时间的基线预测。
subtitles.en: So I think over, if you look at the China growth, 4.6% is still a baseline forecast for the rest of this year.

subtitles.zh: 好，我认为这回答了关于宏观的第一个问题，对吧？
subtitles.en: Okay, so I think that answered the first question about macro, right?

subtitles.zh: 所以引向市场策略。我们总是喜欢杠铃策略。
subtitles.en: So leading to the market strategy. So we always like a barbell strategy.

subtitles.zh: 防御端，金融板块，提供收益，我认为这已经在表现。
subtitles.en: On the defensive side, financials, let's give you like, you know, income, you know, so I think that is already performing.

subtitles.zh: 对吧？然后你有科技成长的选择，比如科技硬件、AI、光学，回到我早先的观点，
subtitles.en: Right? So then you have an option of the tech growth, like being the tech hardware, you know, the AI, you know, the optics leading to moving back to my earlier point about,

subtitles.zh: 如果你看穿近期波动，回到自给自足模式，这将驱动增长，
subtitles.en: if you look beyond the near-term turbulence, going back, you know, to the self-reliance mode, this is going to drive your growth, you know, into,

subtitles.zh: 进入明年和后年。
subtitles.en: you know, into next year and the year after.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

briefs.speaker_context: Founder and CEO of AI-squared Robotics (AI² Robotics), a Chinese humanoid robotics company
briefs.current_title: AI²机器人郭彦东：轮式人形机器人，如何破解通用操作难题？
current_title_lines: 如何破解通用操作难题？

subtitles.zh: 你可能注意到，我们使用同一类型的硬件、同一单元，将它们应用于不同场景。
subtitles.en: Well, if you may notice that, we are using the same type of hardware, same unit, to apply them in different scenarios.

subtitles.zh: 带轮子的人形机器人，对吧？是的，带轮子的人形机器人。
subtitles.en: Humanoid with wheels, right? Yeah, humanoid with wheels.

subtitles.zh: 这绕过了灵巧性问题以及移动性挑战。
subtitles.en: That gets around the challenge of the dexterity problem, the ambulatory challenges.

subtitles.zh: 是的，但我们仍需解决所谓通用性的问题。
subtitles.en: Yeah, but we still have to need to solve the problem to this kind of so-called general purpose.

subtitles.zh: 我们需要机器人操作咖啡机。
subtitles.en: We need to robot to operate coffee machines.

subtitles.zh: 我们需要机器人在工厂里操作其他机器。
subtitles.en: We need robots to operate other machines in the factories.

subtitles.zh: 我们利用同一单元的机器人，这就是这一代机器人的独特之处。
subtitles.en: We use leverages, same unit of robots. That is the uniqueness of this generation of robots.

subtitles.zh: 所以，真正的挑战是找到基础模型。
subtitles.en: So, the real challenge is to find a foundation model.

subtitles.zh: 有了这个基础模型，人们可以理解人，而机器人可以理解不同环境并操作不同物品。
subtitles.en: With this foundation model, people can understand people. Others, the robot can understand different environment and operate on different stuff.

subtitles.zh: 再比如，媒体中心的机器人操作人们常用的咖啡机。
subtitles.en: For another example, like the robots in the media center, the robot operate on coffee machines, people typically use.

subtitles.zh: 所以，它就像调酒师或咖啡馆好友。
subtitles.en: So, it's like a bartender or cafe bestie.

subtitles.zh: 而且无论光线如何、机器放在哪里、机器类型怎么变，机器人都能操作机器。
subtitles.en: And the robot can operate the machine no matter how the light is, no matter where you put the machine, no matter how change the type of the machine.

subtitles.zh: 但它必须有比制作咖啡更深入的应用。
subtitles.en: But it has to be more profound applications than making coffee.

subtitles.zh: 是的，没错。
subtitles.en: Yeah, exactly.

subtitles.en: Yeah, exactly. So, your foundational model you're talking about is alpha brain.

subtitles.zh: 是的。我们从Unitree的王兴兴那里听说，通用人工智能的进展可能比我们预期的要快得多。

subtitles.zh: 你同意吗？是的，我认为事情发展得越来越快。
subtitles.en: than we ever expected. Would you agree with that? Yeah, I think things grow faster and faster.

subtitles.zh: 通常，人们自己写代码，但如今，许多工程师利用大基础模型来写代码。
subtitles.en: Typically, people write codes all by themselves, but these days, a lot of engineers leverage large foundation model to write code.

subtitles.zh: 我认为很多事情发展得越来越快。在2023年，我们是首批真正为机器人发明这种大基础模型的公司之一。

subtitles.zh: 我们持续创新。我们不断发表论文，不断申请专利。

subtitles.zh: 我们开源了名为Alpha Brain的大基础模型。
subtitles.en: And we open source the large foundation model we call that alpha brain.

subtitles.zh: 这样许多人就能用我们的Alpha Brain让他们的机器人越来越智能。
subtitles.en: So that many people can use our alpha brain to make their robot smarter and smarter.

subtitles.zh: 你认为商业化为什么还没有真正起飞？

briefs.current_title: AI²机器人郭彦东：商业化刚起步，数据多样性才是关键？

subtitles.zh: 您认为商业化为何尚未真正起飞？
subtitles.en: What do you think commercialization really hasn't taken off yet?

subtitles.zh: 这些Alpha机器人，不是大脑，而是带轮子的实际人形机器人，有多少台？
subtitles.en: And how many of these alpha bots, not the brain, the alpha bots, the actual humanoid robots with wheels?

subtitles.zh: 部署了多少台？今年和明年的交付情况如何？
subtitles.en: How many are deployed and what are your deliveries like this year and next?

subtitles.zh: 这个问题很好，因为这种人形机器人，我们的通用机器人，并非为非常专业化的任务而设计。
subtitles.en: I see this is a very good question, because this humanoid, our general purpose robots, is not designed for a very specialized task.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们发明硬件、设计硬件、训练基础模型，然后为所有这些机器人找到大量应用。
subtitles.en: So we invent the hardware, we design the hardware, we train the foundation model, then we find a lot of applications for all these robots.

subtitles.zh: 正如我刚才提到的，我们已经找到一些非常有趣、非常有用的应用，比如刚提到的，另外我想提的是这次APEC。
subtitles.en: As I just mentioned, we already find some very interesting applications, very useful applications, such as I just mentioned, and another thing I want to mention is that this is APEC.

subtitles.zh: 我们甚至与PSA新加坡港务局找到应用，帮助港口工人。
subtitles.en: We even find applications with PSA, port of Singapore authority to help the workers at the port.

subtitles.zh: 所有这些应用，首先对开展业务至关重要。
subtitles.en: So all these applications, first of all, is very crucial to run the business.

subtitles.zh: 其次，所有这些不同应用帮助机器人公司追踪数据。
subtitles.en: Second of all, all these different applications help robot company to track data.

subtitles.zh: 因此数据的多样性帮助我们训练机器人的大脑，让机器人越来越智能。
subtitles.en: So the diversity of the data help us to train the brain of the robot to make the robot smarter and smarter.

subtitles.zh: 说到这个，算力短缺对你们有多大影响？
subtitles.en: Well, speaking of which, how are you impacted by perhaps computing power shortages

briefs.speaker: Brian Moynihan
briefs.speaker_context: Chairman and CEO, Bank of America
briefs.current_title: 美银CEO莫伊尼汉：发行节奏延迟，市场信心待修复

subtitles.zh: 团队在标注方面做得不错。是什么让你确信活动只是延迟，而非改道？
subtitles.en: And the team's done a good job of captioning their pieces. What gives you confidence the activity is delayed and not to route?

subtitles.zh: 我们谈论的公司正从核心业务在下季度转移。
subtitles.en: Well, the companies we're talking about moving from this core next quarter.

subtitles.zh: 他们已在路上。只需确保一切就绪，让他们能顺利推进。
subtitles.en: They're on a path. It's just a matter of making sure all the ducks in a row enter space for them to get out there.

subtitles.zh: 他们所处的领域与英伟达不同。
subtitles.en: They're in different fields than Nvidia.

subtitles.zh: 或者，抱歉，是Anthropic。
subtitles.en: Or, excuse me, then, Anthropic.

subtitles.zh: 所以这些是可以完成的IPO。
subtitles.en: So these are IPOs that can get done.

subtitles.zh: 有时只需时间让市场参与者将注意力从当前事务转移到较小标的。
subtitles.en: Sometimes it just takes time to get the investor's attention off of what's going on now onto a smaller cup.

subtitles.zh: 这些标的的倍数低于Anthropic。
subtitles.en: These are multiple smaller than Anthropic.

subtitles.zh: 这算是视频中的弗洛伊德式口误，不是Anthropic，但我觉得确实引出了话题。
subtitles.en: It was sort of a Freudian slip in video, not Anthropic, but I think it does kind of raise.

subtitles.zh: 我们会谈到他们。我们会继续对话。我的意思是，我确实想问多少。
subtitles.en: We'll get to them. We'll get to the conversation. I mean, I do want to ask how much.

subtitles.zh: 这可能在短期内给交易达成设置障碍，因为对许多公司而言，这种财务支持措施会带来不确定性。
subtitles.en: That's going to potentially create that roadblock to get the deals done in the near term of the sort of overhang of what that backstop looks like financially to so many different companies.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这是基准情景，当然我们也关注市场参与者的部分担忧，并与他们进行了大量交流。

subtitles.zh: 我认为中国肯定在重回视野，部分原因是其提供分散配置的能力。

subtitles.zh: 如果你看中国，我认为即便全球AI资本开支等方面存在一些担忧。

subtitles.zh: 相反，我们仍预测约10%的盈利增长，且估值并不太具挑战性。

subtitles.zh: 我认为过去几年，市盈率一直低于历史平均水平。

subtitles.zh: 所以如果应用这一点，我认为中国仍有10%至15%的上行空间是舒适的。

briefs.current_title: 瑞银全球研究主管：芯片自给率提升，科技硬件增长能否持续？
current_title_lines: 科技硬件增长能否持续？

subtitles.zh: 没错，关键问题在于，它们的增长当然来自科技。
subtitles.en: Exactly. That key question. So the growth of them, of course, is coming from tech.

subtitles.zh: 当然，像硬件，你知道，一切都集中在那。
subtitles.en: And of course, like hardware, you know, everything is at that.

subtitles.zh: 我认为现在推动中国的另一个因素，正呼应你提到的自主可控。
subtitles.en: I think now driving China is another thing that is coming to your point about like the self reliance.

subtitles.zh: 谈到AI，我的意思是，对AI芯片的需求毫无疑问是存在的。
subtitles.en: So talking about AI, I mean there's no debate like the demand for AI for chips is definitely there.

subtitles.zh: 供应限制是主要问题，我认为这也是过去几周市场调整的原因之一。
subtitles.en: Supply constraint is office. I think there's also why leading to the market correction in the last couple of weeks.

subtitles.zh: 但现在随着自主可控回归，我们做了一些中期预测，比如到2028年。
subtitles.en: But now with the self reliance coming back, we do some forecasts about like on a medium time basis, let's say going to 2028.

subtitles.zh: 我们的预测是，中国国内芯片出货量将达到约1000万颗。
subtitles.en: Our forecast is China will have domestic chips shipment of like 10 million units.

subtitles.zh: 这大约是今年预测的4.4倍。
subtitles.en: So which is like a 4.4s of forecast for this year.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这种国内平衡的主题正在回归。
subtitles.en: So I guess this domestic balance theme is coming back.

subtitles.zh: 因此，科技硬件增长将继续保持强劲。
subtitles.en: And as a result, tech hardware growth will continue to stay robust.

subtitles.zh: 好的，那么你现在对内地市场最有信心。
subtitles.en: Okay, so you have the strongest conviction in China right now.

briefs.current_title: 瑞银全球研究主管：宏观数据波动下，杠铃策略如何应对？
current_title_lines: 宏观数据波动下如何应对？

subtitles.zh: 很多问题。好，我按要点总结一下，好吗？
subtitles.en: Many questions. Okay, let me sum it up in cue points, right?

subtitles.zh: 我认为首先，就宏观数据而言，我们不能只看昨天或单一数据就形成观点。
subtitles.en: I think firstly, in terms of the macro data, let's not just take yesterday or one single data, you know, following a view.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这个轨迹，如果看过去一个季度从九月到十月，整个趋势是走向温和稳定，就内地宏观而言，
subtitles.en: I think that trajectory, if you look at the past quarter from September leading October, the whole trend is leading to a moderate stability, you know, in terms of the China macro,

subtitles.zh: 这符合预期。所以我们仍有信心。
subtitles.en: which is kind of the expectation it is. So we are still confident.

subtitles.zh: 我会展示给你看，因为数据似乎显示相反。
subtitles.en: I'll show you that because the data seems to be showing the opposite.

subtitles.zh: 我认为如果看九月和十月的组合，这实际上是稳定的情况。
subtitles.en: I think if you look at the combination of September October, this is actually a case of stability.

subtitles.zh: 我们不要单挑昨天。是的。
subtitles.en: Let's not single out yesterday. Yes.

subtitles.zh: 我只是开始获取你提到的数据。是的，没错。
subtitles.en: I'm just starting to get the data to which you're reporting. Yeah, exactly.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，如果看中国增长，4.6%仍是今年剩余时间的基线预测。

subtitles.zh: 所以引向市场策略。我们总是喜欢杠铃策略。
subtitles.en: So leading to the market strategy. So we always like a barbell strategy.

subtitles.zh: 防御端，金融板块，提供收益，我认为这已经在表现。
subtitles.en: On the defensive side, financials, let's give you like, you know, income, you know, so I think that is already performing.

subtitles.zh: 对吧？然后你有科技成长的选择，比如科技硬件、AI、光学，回到我早先的观点，
subtitles.en: Right? So then you have an option of the tech growth, like being the tech hardware, you know, the AI, you know, the optics leading to moving back to my earlier point about,

subtitles.zh: 如果你看穿近期波动，回到自给自足模式，这将驱动增长，
subtitles.en: if you look beyond the near-term turbulence, going back, you know, to the self-reliance mode, this is going to drive your growth, you know, into,

subtitles.zh: 进入明年和后年。
subtitles.en: you know, into next year and the year after.
